text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her races in the Twinkle Series 
settling down, we arrived at the hot 
spring inn won from the lottery earlier.

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Innkeeper
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia-san, Trainer-san. Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the new hot springs that you 
all helped so greatly with... The work has 
been successfully completed! Please, go 
ahead and enjoy yourselves!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you!!
choice_data_list: Shall we head in right away?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No! First, let's wander around the city—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny told me, "It's better 
to take it easy"...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
They're saying something completely 
different from me! What's the meaning of 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. Because the voice of fate is my 
own voice...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Man, Trainer, you really know everything, 
don't you?!
choice_data_list:
I try to keep a close eye on you... after 
all.

I try to keep a close eye on you... after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Intended?? They're actually watching you 
really closely, aren't they!
choice_data_list:
There are times when I can't catch up to 
you either...

There are times I can't keep up with you 
either...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, decided! Today, we're taking 
everything slow!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!! There's so much green...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Look waaaaaaaay out in the 
distance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's nothing out there! See, they 
say greenery is good for your eyes, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Those are your precious eyes that always 
work hard to take everything in, after 
all. Treat them with care!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! Even if you close your eyes 
today, I won't disappear!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That's why I picked the "slow" one!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Once we've spaced out to our hearts' 
content, let's hit the hot springs too! We 
can take it totally easy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That felt so good!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You were waiting for me!?
choice_data_list:
Just in case, so I can follow you 
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...! Traiiiner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took Epiphaneia back to the room for 
now, and after calming her down, I 
listened to what she had to say...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just... so deeply moved! You really, 
truly care about me..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
He'll just keep chasing me forever and 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Is that your supervisory responsibility 
as a Trainer speaking?
choice_data_list:
That's part of it, of course. But above 
all...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Because it's fun following you around.
Because following you is so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up with Epiphaneia is tough... but 
wherever she takes me, far more fun than I 
could ever imagine is guaranteed to be 
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: So let's also do "strolling around town."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! Let's do it, let's go right 
now, let's keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run right beside you, that's 
why!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: From right beside me— show me your smile!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Epiphaneia and 
myself...
